title: 第11章 我的蜘蛛精邻居第12章 狗日的任务又来了
slug: 系统绑错人龙套被迫走主角剧本
content_zh:
“那你租房的预算有多少啊。”
邱师兄拿出房簿，熟练地翻到了最后几页，那里记录的，自然是龙涛这种身家唯一负担得起的地方。
“师兄，我这么多年的灵石都是你发的，我能剩多少钱你还不清楚吗，直接给我找几个主峰山脚的便宜房子就好了。”
“我记得你家不是挺殷实的嘛，租房子这事他们应该还是会帮忙的吧。”
邱师兄一边翻着簿子，一边头也不抬地问到，
“当初他们为了把我送进宗门已经花了不少了，为了个房子我可不好意思，我妹到时候都要笑话我。”
“眼光放长远点！”
邱师兄终于抬起头，正色道，“你这杂灵根能在这年纪升上外门，已经算祖坟冒青烟了！
再熬几年，站稳脚跟，就能反哺家里了。”
说到这，他手指在房簿上点了一下道，
“喏...这个房子怎么样，西北边山脚那，价格不错，就是离栖霞镇远了些，上山也要绕点路。”
中介嘴里的绕点路，绝对不是一点，龙涛立刻拒绝，何况西北山脚那大家都知道风大，加上交通不便，通常没人愿意住。
邱师兄似乎早料到他会拒绝，毕竟那地方确实谁住谁糟心。
他手指在房簿上又滑了几行，停在一处，脸上露出玩味的笑容。
“那...这个怎么样，西南边那一块儿，凤影亭附近，离栖霞镇不远，价格也不贵，一个月两块灵石。”
“这么便宜？！
有点门道在里面吧？”
龙涛第一时间就感觉不对劲，凤影亭那一带可是个好地段，去主峰上面或者山下的栖霞镇都方便，正常来说月租怎么也得有个四块下品灵石。
“师兄我也不坑你，便宜自然有便宜的道理，这房子的邻居是南边万妖山来的妖族，所以嘛...比较难搞。”
“妖族啊......”

龙涛的呼吸微微一滞，脑子里瞬间不受控制地闪过那些风情万种的九尾狐妖、腰肢曼妙的蛇族美人...难道...
“打住！
打住！”
邱师兄一看他那飘忽的眼神，就知道他在想什么。
“别想美事了！
真要是那些狐妖蛇妖美人儿，这房子还能轮得到你？早被内门那帮人抢破头了！
隔壁是个蜘蛛精。
而且化形没修到家。
上半身...勉强能看，下半身嘛......”
邱师兄用手比划了一个夸张的手势，“六条大长腿，带毛刺儿的那种！
咋样？能忍就租，这价儿是真没得挑！”
龙涛听到这话瞬间打了个颤，宗门和南方山脉的妖族关系一直维持的不错，所以会有不少妖族“留学生”
过来交流学习，蜘蛛精他也见过几个。
呵呵...和前世各种二次元作品里的异族幻想美女不同，实际上的蜘蛛精生着复眼与螯肢，行走时带着节肢摩擦声，还有恶心的表皮，每次近距离遇见，都有股生理性的反感。
但他挣扎了一下，还是觉得现在一切得以修炼为主，这些困难和脑子里那个系统给的任务相比，都不是个事。
加上两个灵石的价格太有诱惑力，最终他还是给出了自己的回答。
“行...行吧，蜘蛛就蜘蛛，和穷神比起来也没什么好怕的，这房子我要了。”
“痛快！
这个年纪能升到外门的杂灵根，果然都是有魄力的，来...师兄我也不让你烦心，签个字按个手印就好，剩下的那些琐事、还有你从大通铺搬出来的手续，都交给我，你直接去搬家吧。”

content_en:
"What's your budget for renting a house?"
Senior Brother Qiu took out the house book and skillfully turned to the last few pages. What was recorded there was naturally the only place that Long Tao could afford.
"Senior brother, you have given me all my spiritual stones for so many years. Don't you know how much money I have left? Just find me some cheap houses at the foot of the main peak."
"I remember that your family is quite wealthy. They should still be able to help with renting a house."
Senior Brother Qiu asked without raising his head while flipping through the book,
"They already spent a lot of money to send me to the sect. I'm embarrassed to have a house. My sister will laugh at me then."
“Think long term!”
Senior Brother Qiu finally raised his head and said sternly, "If you can reach the outer sect at this age with your miscellaneous spiritual roots, it's already like smoke rising from your ancestral grave!
After a few more years to gain a firm foothold, I can help support my family. "
Having said this, he clicked his finger on the house book and said,
"Well...how about this house? It's at the foot of the mountain in the northwest. The price is good, but it's a little far away from Qixia Town, and you have to take a detour to go up the mountain."
The detour mentioned by the agent was definitely not just a small one. Long Tao immediately rejected it, not to mention that everyone at the foot of the northwest mountain knew that it was windy and coupled with the inconvenient transportation, usually no one wanted to live there.
Senior Brother Qiu seemed to have expected that he would refuse. After all, it was really a disaster for whoever lived in that place.
His fingers slid a few more lines on the house book, stopping at one place with a playful smile on his face.
"Then...how about this one? The one in the southwest, near Fengying Pavilion, not far from Qixia Town. The price is not expensive, two spiritual stones a month."
"So cheap?!
Is there some secret in it? "
Long Tao felt something was wrong at the first moment. The area around Fengying Pavilion was a good location. It was convenient to go to Qixia Town on top of the main peak or at the foot of the mountain. Normally, the monthly rent would require four low-grade spiritual stones.
"Senior brother, I won't cheat you. It's cheap for a reason. The neighbors of this house are demons from the Ten Thousand Demon Mountains in the south, so...it's more difficult to deal with."
"Monster clan..."
Long Tao's breathing stagnated slightly, and his mind flashed uncontrollably at those charming nine-tailed fox demons and snake beauties with graceful waists... Could it be...
"Stop it!
Stop it! "
Senior Brother Qiu knew what he was thinking as soon as he looked at his wandering eyes.
"Stop thinking about good things!
If it were those fox demons, snake demons and beauties, would this house still have your turn? His head had already been snatched away by the gang from the inner sect!
There's a spider spirit next door.
And I haven’t mastered the transformation yet.
The upper body... I can barely see, but the lower body..."
Senior Brother Qiu made an exaggerated gesture with his hand, "Six long legs, the kind with burrs!
How is it? Rent if you can bear it, the price is really no choice! "
Long Tao shuddered when he heard this. The relationship between the sect and the demon clan in the Southern Mountains has always been good, so there will be many "students" from the demon clan.
Come here to exchange and learn, and he has met a few Spider Spirits.
Haha... Unlike the alien fantasy beauties in various two-dimensional works in previous lives, the actual spider spirit has compound eyes and chelicerae. It makes a friction sound when walking and has a disgusting skin. Every time it is encountered at close range, there is a physiological revulsion.
But after struggling for a while, he still felt that everything now focused on cultivation, and these difficulties were nothing compared to the tasks given by the system in his mind.
In addition, the price of two spirit stones was too tempting, so he finally gave his answer.
"Okay... okay, spiders are spiders, they have nothing to be afraid of compared to the poor god. I want this house."
"Happy!
The miscellaneous spirit roots that can rise to the outer sect at this age are indeed courageous. Come on...Senior brother, I won’t let you worry. Just sign and press your fingerprints. The rest of the trivial matters, as well as your moving out of DatongpuLeave all the procedures to me, and you can go directly to move. "
